adjudication.rationale: In `Discourse.Group.removeMember`, the method returns the DELETE ajax promise, but inside `.then` it calls `self.findMembers();` without returning it. So any caller chaining off `removeMember()` will see it resolve before the member list refresh completes, and failures from `findMembers()` won’t be propagated through the returned promise. However, in this diff the only shown caller (`admin-group` controller’s `removeMember` action) doesn’t chain off the returned promise at all, so no verifiable broken behavior is demonstrated purely from the diff—this is mainly a promise/flow robustness issue.
